note: Short 'Why did Blackbeard light fuses in his beard?' (granskning/blackbeard-fuses/manus.md, version 2), opening with the hook lab's chosen clip b (its first two lines); bm_george.

lines.text: No. Watch him get ready for a fight.
First he twisted his beard, which grew up to his eyes, into little tails with ribbons.
Then he tucked slow-burning fuses under his hat, so they smoked beside his beard.
Add six pistols across his chest.
Now he looked like something out of hell.
It was probably meant to make crews give up without a fight.
Nearly all of this comes from one book, printed six years after he died.
So the fire was a costume.
